title: How to do The Reject Step (Hip Hop Dance Moves Tutorial) | Mihran Kirakosian

method.teacher_system: Mihran demonstrates the reject step with music, breaks down the footwork and body momentum in slow motion, and then guides learners through repetitions at increasing tempos with music.

practices.what: Performs the full reject step to music from the side view as a demonstration.
Breaks down the first step: jumping back on the left leg and kicking the right leg up.
Breaks down the second step: taking the right leg back and hopping forward on the left leg.
Demonstrates the footwork close-up from the side view, repeating the sequence slowly.
Teaches the switch where the right leg goes down and the left leg kicks up.
Practices the continuous footwork slowly with counts, emphasizing the 'and' beats.
Instructs learners to keep momentum going forward with the body, bouncing within oneself.
Practices the complete routine to music at a slower tempo.
Executes the full reject step routine with music at full tempo.

beliefs.belief: Complex moves should be broken down into 'real simple' individual components before being combined.

feelings.response: Encourages the learner to find the 'vibe' of the dance, focusing on the feeling of jumping within oneself.

moments.says: Welcomes the learner back and introduces the 'Reject' step, also known as the 'Jerk' step, promising to break it down after a music demonstration.
Breaks down the first jump and kick, calling it 'real simple' to build confidence before adding more complexity.
Uses a close-up shot of the feet to ensure the learner can see the weight distribution and foot placement clearly.
Repeats the sequence slowly several times to ensure the learner has mastered the basic rhythm before increasing the speed.
Reminds the learner to keep their momentum moving forward with their body to maintain the correct 'vibe' and balance.
Transitions to practicing with music, starting slow to help the learner find the beat.
Leads the final practice at full tempo with music, repeating the move multiple times to solidify the learning.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and rhythmic by breaking down a high-energy move into manageable, repeatable segments.

struggles.theme: Trouble keeping balance and staying on one leg
Getting confused about which leg to move
Looking like playing hopscotch instead of dancing
Putting the steps together because mind forgets next move

clicked.theme: Clear step-by-step breakdown made it easy to learn
Learning the move in just a few minutes after struggling
Turning off the sound helped avoid leg confusion

meant.theme: Helped pass dancing test and feel like a professional
Brought back nostalgia of school life learning dance

method.limits: Audio track in the video consists of instrumental beat looping without spoken voiceover during demonstration sections; teacher's spoken instructions are limited to intro and transitional segments.
